title: ForecastHour
description: One element of normalize(forecast, marine).hours in public/js/api/openmeteo.js -> public/js/score.js (both open-meteo-integrator). Field names follow the reference normalizer in knowledge/open-meteo-integrator/examples/01-openmeteo-client/openmeteo.mjs (docs/01 §5). Units are fixed by the request: degF, mph, inch, ft. SST is converted to degF (seaTempF). Marine fields are present but null when Marine is missing or snapped too far away: never absent, never guessed. Any value can be null (Open-Meteo nulls); a null core field makes the hour unscorable (docs/01 §5.2).

time.description: Local wall-clock hour as Open-Meteo returns it (timezone=America/New_York)

seaTempF.description: Converted from Open-Meteo's degC; a degC value (e.g. 26.4) would fail the minimum only by luck, so the test also checks the conversion
